title: Strong-Ridge preservation and sparse-part residual diagnostic
purpose: Determine whether cached part scores can selectively correct a strong DINOv2 CLS-Ridge classifier and whether global CLS/mean-patch decision fusion improves the strongest foundation baseline.

data_control.dataset: same frozen CUB episode 1 train-only OOF predictions and features

arms.ridge_ensembles: z-normalized decision fusion of CLS-Ridge with CLS+mean-patch Ridge; fixed patch weights 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0
arms.ridge_part_residual: within the already stored LogReg top-10 candidate set, fuse CLS-Ridge candidate decisions with equal-part or confusion-aware local scores; preserve the Ridge prediction unchanged if it is absent from that set

interpretation.success_if: best arm improves at least 0.5 pp over CLS_RIDGE
interpretation.confirmation_requirement: freeze the winning construction and alpha, then run untouched episodes 2 and 3
